title: docs(spec): the security-catalog migration entry and the D6 gloss stop saying a permission set holds one name per deployment
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XNWAtCgQojxw26B4VzapMZz)_

Fixes #33388

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：安全目录覆盖迁移条目（`security-catalog-environment-overlay-refused`）的 `reason` 开头不再说「岗位、权限集、能力每个部署一个名字」，改为该条目真正的主题「环境目录和包从不共持一个名字」；ADR-0146 D6 分类依据的注释改为「安全目录不接受覆盖」；权限集指南的单持有者清单补上「环境」，「授予按名字指向权限集」改为「按包和名字」。
- 为什么改：#32742 之后权限集名字按命名空间持有，原句对权限集已不成立；#33384 改了 describe 和指南主段，这里收掉剩下的三处文字。
- 风险与回滚：只改说明文字和注释，不动 schema、规则、迁移条目的 id/surface/replacement 或运行时；spec patch changeset。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.security-catalog-environment-overlay-refused.ts` 的 `reason` 开头两行；其次 `content/docs/permissions/permission-sets.mdx` 的两处改动。
- 两分钟验证：`git grep -n "hold one name per deployment" -- packages/spec/src`，预期零命中。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.security-catalog-environment-overlay-refused.ts`, `reason` only. FROM "Positions, permission sets and capabilities hold one name per deployment, and a package registering a name the environment catalog already holds was already refused on a hot install." TO "The environment catalog and a package never hold one name: a package registering a name the environment catalog already holds was already refused on a hot install." The rest of `reason` and every other field (`id`, `surface`, `replacement`, `acceptanceCriteria`) are byte-identical.
- `packages/spec/src/kernel/customization-package.ts`, the `adr_0146_d6_security_catalog` line of the `OverrideClassificationBasis` doc comment. FROM "D6: one name per deployment (permission sets, positions, capabilities)" TO "D6: the security catalog takes no override (permission sets, positions, capabilities)". Comment only.
- `content/docs/permissions/permission-sets.mdx` (review N4/N5 of #33384, added to the card by the seat):
  - the one-holder list #33384 added now names the environment: "…a platform package (`base`, `system`, `sys`), the environment and the platform-requested `guest_portal` keep one holder", the same list and order as the `PermissionSetSchema.name` describe;
  - the "One authoritative store" paragraph: FROM "a grant names its set by name (`sys_user_permission_set.permission_set`)" TO "a grant names its set by its package and name (`sys_user_permission_set.permission_set_package` and `permission_set`)", matching "each granted by its own package and name" below it and the grant object's (package, name) key.
- `.changeset/33388-security-catalog-entry-reason.md`: `@objectstack/spec` patch, since the entry's `reason` ships in spec `dist` (`dist/migrations/index.{js,mjs}`) and in the generated upgrade guide.

## Why

Since PR #32742 a permission-set name has one holder per namespace, so "permission sets hold one name per deployment" is false in present tense. The migration entry's subject (an environment-wide row and a package never share a name) still holds, so the reason now opens with that. ADR-0146 D6's reason a permission set takes no override is unchanged, so the gloss names it instead of the old name rule.

## Tests

- No behaviour changes, so no test is added and nothing is ablated. Neither old sentence is pinned: on `origin/main`, `git grep "one name per deployment"` hits `packages/spec/src` only at the two edited lines and at `permission.zod.ts:1209` (positions and capabilities, still true), and no test asserts either edited text (the test hits are refusal sentences of other types, comments and one test title; see Acceptance notes).
- Projections: every projection of the entry is gitignored. After `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/spec…`, the regenerated `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts` and `packages/spec/dist/migrations/index.{js,mjs}` carry the new sentence and no longer carry the old one. Nothing to commit.
- On `ab082955`: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` exit 0; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/migrations src/kernel/customization-package`: Test Files 6 passed (6), Tests 263 passed (263) (lock VERDICT command-exit 0).

## Acceptance notes

Left as they are, outside this card's surface:

- `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts:2818` and `:2880` (the cold-boot and hot-install refusal sentences of `SecurityCatalogNameConflictError`) still say "Positions, permission sets and capabilities each hold one name per deployment: an assignment names a position or a permission set by its bare name". The refusals stay right where they fire for a permission set (an environment item, co-owners of one namespace, a platform holder), but the stated reason no longer is, since a grant carries `permission_set_package`. Runtime text in `@objectstack/objectql`; reported to the seat.
- ADR-0048's 2026-10-08 addendum, ADR-0146 D6 text (`:263`, `:472`), and test comments (`showcase-security.ts:32`, `showcase-d7-default-profile.dogfood.test.ts:65`, `protocol-boot-hydration-scoped.test.ts:217`) and the `served-override.test.ts:70` test title: decision records and comments, not touched.
- Released `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md` entries carry the old sentence: release-owned, not touched.

## Verification

On `ab082955`: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 103 commands, run one by one with `timeout 900`, each exit code captured before any pipe.

- 101 exited 0 in the loop.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-examples` exited 3 in the loop (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: `packages/client-react/dist` held no declarations). After building the client and client-react closures it exited 0 ("344 prose examples type-check across 3 surface(s)").
- `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: it needs every package's `dist`; only the spec, lint, objectql, client and client-react closures were built), so it is NOT MEASURED here and left to CI.
- `--ran` reconciliation: "103 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 102 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (1 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)".
- Also run: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` exited 1 only because `check:test-typecheck`'s `tsc -p` died "without diagnostics" under load; `check:test-typecheck` alone then exited 0 (52 files / 240 errors / 131 pinned signatures held). The other 13 artifacts read up to date, so nothing checked in moves. `node scripts/check-nul-bytes.mjs` exit 0.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [ ] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` is CI's run, not run locally.)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed (none checked in moves; see Verification).
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [ ] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done. (Left to the seat's review.)
